name: Plak for YouTube Music
author: Kelbresqe
description: Your real YouTube Music account in the Omarchy bar: search, playlists, library, queue editing, synced lyrics, history, likes and radio, drawn from your theme. English and Turkish. Signs in through a normal Google login; no cookies or tokens ever leave the browser.

barWidget.description: Plak: now playing, playlists, mixes, queue and synced lyrics for your YouTube Music account

schema.label: Browser
schema.description: Executable name of a Chromium-family browser. Empty = your default browser if it is Chromium-based, else the first of Chrome, Brave, Chromium, Vivaldi, Edge found.

schema.label: Show in bar when nothing is playing
Reopen YouTube Music automatically if its window is closed
Keep the YouTube Music window in a hidden special workspace
Pause when another player starts, resume when it stops
schema.description: Another media player (a video in your browser, mpv, Spotify…) starting pauses the music; once every other player has been quiet for a few seconds it resumes, unless you paused or played it yourself in between.
